rules.description: The host heartbeat is no longer current.
rules.runbook: Verify the agent, host power, network path, and clock before acting on child alerts.

rules.description: The monitoring agent heartbeat is missing.
rules.runbook: Check the agent service, enrollment state, certificate, queue, and network reachability.

rules.description: Telemetry is older than the accepted freshness window.
rules.runbook: Check collector errors, source status, queue delay, clock skew, and central ingest lag.

rules.description: CPU usage remains high.
rules.runbook: Inspect per-core modes, load per core, PSI, throttling, and top processes.

rules.description: CPU iowait remains high.
rules.runbook: Correlate storage latency, queue depth, filesystem errors, and busy processes.

rules.description: CPU steal time remains high.
rules.runbook: Confirm virtualization contention and compare host capacity with workload demand.

rules.description: Runnable or blocked work exceeds CPU capacity.
rules.runbook: Compare load with CPU modes, PSI, process state, and I/O latency.

rules.description: Tasks are stalling for CPU time.
rules.runbook: Inspect CPU saturation, throttling, runnable processes, and container limits.

rules.description: Available memory is persistently low.
rules.runbook: Inspect memory PSI, swap activity, recent growth, OOM events, and top consumers.

rules.description: Tasks are stalling for memory.
rules.runbook: Inspect reclaim pressure, swap churn, cgroup limits, and OOM evidence.

rules.description: Swap usage remains high.
rules.runbook: Confirm whether swap is active pressure or retained cold pages using PSI and swap I/O.

rules.description: Swap I/O indicates sustained thrashing.
rules.runbook: Inspect memory pressure, allocation growth, storage latency, and workload limits.

rules.description: The kernel OOM killer terminated a process.
rules.runbook: Inspect the affected process or cgroup, memory pressure, limits, and the preceding metric window.

rules.description: Filesystem capacity is running low.
rules.runbook: Identify growth, retention failures, deleted-open files, and the owning workload.

rules.description: Filesystem capacity is critically low.
rules.runbook: Protect writes, identify safe cleanup, and verify retention before removing data.

rules.description: Filesystem inode capacity is nearly exhausted.
rules.runbook: Find directories creating many files and verify cleanup will not remove active data.

rules.description: A writable filesystem has become read-only.
rules.runbook: Inspect kernel and filesystem errors and avoid remounting until storage integrity is understood.

rules.description: Disk request latency remains high.
rules.runbook: Correlate utilization, queue depth, device errors, filesystem activity, and workload I/O.

rules.description: The storage stack reported an I/O error.
rules.runbook: Inspect kernel evidence, device health, cabling or power, and filesystem state.

rules.description: A RAID array is degraded.
rules.runbook: Identify the failed member and follow the array-specific replacement and rebuild procedure.

rules.description: A device health check reports failure.
rules.runbook: Confirm the device report, protect backups, and plan replacement without destructive tests.

rules.description: Interface error rate remains elevated.
rules.runbook: Inspect the affected interface, link negotiation, physical path, driver, and peer counters.

rules.description: Interface packet drops remain elevated.
rules.runbook: Inspect queue pressure, bandwidth, interface counters, and host resource saturation.

rules.description: TCP retransmissions indicate degraded connection quality.
rules.runbook: Correlate interface errors, drops, latency, path changes, and peer health.

rules.description: Connection tracking capacity is nearly exhausted.
rules.runbook: Inspect connection growth, timeouts, traffic sources, and the configured limit.

rules.description: File descriptor usage is near the system limit.
rules.runbook: Identify the process retaining descriptors and verify system and process limits.

rules.description: PID usage is near the system limit.
rules.runbook: Inspect process creation, zombies, service loops, and configured PID limits.

rules.description: Zombie process count remains elevated.
rules.runbook: Identify parent processes that are not reaping children and inspect recent service failures.

rules.description: An allow-listed systemd unit is failed.
rules.runbook: Inspect unit status and sanitized journal evidence before considering a restart.

rules.description: Host time differs materially from the central clock.
rules.runbook: Inspect NTP or timesync status and certificate errors before accepting new samples.

rules.description: The host boot identity changed without a maintenance marker.
rules.runbook: Inspect power, watchdog, kernel, storage, and previous shutdown evidence.

rules.description: Host temperature remains above the safe operating threshold.
rules.runbook: Check cooling, airflow, fan state, ambient temperature, load, and throttling flags.

rules.description: Raspberry Pi firmware reports active throttling.
rules.runbook: Inspect temperature, power flags, frequency, fan state, and workload correlation.

rules.description: Authoritative Raspberry Pi signals report undervoltage.
rules.runbook: Inspect the power supply, cable, connector, load, and firmware or hwmon evidence; voltage alone is not authoritative.

rules.description: An expected container is not running.
rules.runbook: Check host and daemon state, intended maintenance, exit status, and recent container events.

rules.description: A container is repeatedly restarting.
rules.runbook: Inspect exit codes, uptime between starts, health output, limits, image changes, and sanitized logs.

rules.description: A container was terminated by an OOM condition.
rules.runbook: Compare pre-event memory, cgroup limit, host pressure, exit status, and related logs.

rules.description: A configured container healthcheck remains unhealthy.
rules.runbook: Inspect bounded healthcheck output, dependencies, response time, and recent deployment events.

rules.description: Container CPU usage remains near its limit.
rules.runbook: Inspect throttling, workload demand, host CPU pressure, and configured quota or cpuset.

rules.description: Container CPU time is being throttled.
rules.runbook: Compare quota, period, throttled time, host pressure, and service latency.

rules.description: Container memory usage is close to its limit.
rules.runbook: Inspect growth, working set, memory events, host pressure, and whether the limit is appropriate.

rules.description: Container PID usage is close to its limit.
rules.runbook: Inspect process or thread growth, zombies, worker configuration, and the PID limit.

rules.description: Container network errors remain elevated.
rules.runbook: Inspect the container network, veth, bridge, peer interface, DNS, and host link.

rules.description: Container writable-layer usage is high.
rules.runbook: Identify unexpected writes and move durable data to an appropriate volume.

rules.description: A container has no effective memory limit.
rules.runbook: Assess workload behavior and host capacity before defining reservation and limit values.

rules.description: A container has no effective CPU limit.
rules.runbook: Assess latency and contention risk before defining quota or cpuset constraints.

rules.description: A container has no configured healthcheck.
rules.runbook: Define a bounded healthcheck only when it can represent service readiness accurately.

rules.description: A container is running in privileged mode.
rules.runbook: Confirm necessity and replace privileged mode with the minimum capabilities and devices.

rules.description: A container can access a Docker control socket.
rules.runbook: Remove the mount or replace it with a narrowly scoped broker and audited fixed operations.

rules.description: Replicas of a service use different image digests.
rules.runbook: Compare deployment events, expected digest, registry state, and rollout completion.

rules.description: A container uses a mutable latest image tag.
rules.runbook: Pin deployments to a reviewed immutable digest or versioned tag.

rules.description: The Docker daemon or its permitted control path is unavailable.
rules.runbook: Check daemon status, socket permissions, rootless runtime state, and host availability.

rules.description: The Docker event stream is disconnected.
rules.runbook: Check daemon availability, permissions, cursor state, reconnect backoff, and event-gap reconciliation.

rules.description: An HTTP endpoint fails its configured availability check.
rules.runbook: Verify the probe location, DNS, TCP, TLS, expected response, redirects, and upstream dependencies.

rules.description: HTTP p95 latency remains high.
rules.runbook: Separate DNS, connect, TLS, TTFB, and response phases and correlate service saturation.

rules.description: HTTP error rate remains elevated.
rules.runbook: Inspect normalized endpoints, status classes, recent deployment, dependencies, and request volume.

rules.description: A TLS certificate is approaching expiry.
rules.runbook: Confirm SNI, active certificate chain, renewal automation, and deployment before expiry.

rules.description: A TLS certificate is invalid for the configured endpoint.
rules.runbook: Inspect chain validation, hostname, validity period, SNI, and trusted roots.

rules.description: A scheduled job has missed its allowed heartbeat window.
rules.runbook: Check the scheduler, execution host, last run result, duration, and heartbeat delivery path.

rules.description: An allow-listed service process is not running.
rules.runbook: Check the parent service, exit evidence, dependencies, maintenance state, and restart policy.

rules.description: A monitored process remains CPU saturated.
rules.runbook: Inspect process work, threads, host pressure, request load, and recent deployment.

rules.description: A monitored process approaches its memory budget.
rules.runbook: Inspect RSS growth, allocation patterns, host pressure, limits, and recent changes.

rules.description: A process is nearing its file descriptor limit.
rules.runbook: Inspect descriptor types, connection growth, leaks, and process limits.

rules.description: A service worker pool remains near saturation.
rules.runbook: Inspect queue depth, task latency, downstream dependencies, and configured pool size.

rules.description: A service connection pool is exhausted or nearly exhausted.
rules.runbook: Inspect waiters, connection lifetime, downstream health, leaks, and pool limits.

rules.description: A configured database endpoint is unavailable.
rules.runbook: Check network, TLS, authentication scope, server state, capacity, and dependency suppression.

rules.description: Database connections remain near the configured maximum.
rules.runbook: Inspect active and idle connections, pool behavior, long transactions, and leaks.

rules.description: A database transaction remains open for too long.
rules.runbook: Identify the owning sanitized session, lock impact, workload, and safe resolution path.

rules.description: Database lock waits remain elevated.
rules.runbook: Inspect blocking relationships, transaction age, workload changes, and affected service latency.

rules.description: The database detected a deadlock.
rules.runbook: Correlate sanitized transaction classes, application errors, locks, and recent deployment.

rules.description: Database replication lag remains high.
rules.runbook: Inspect replica health, network, write load, storage latency, and replication errors.

rules.description: Database growth predicts near-term capacity exhaustion.
rules.runbook: Validate the trend window, retention, table growth, maintenance, and available storage.

rules.description: A database maintenance task or state requires attention.
rules.runbook: Inspect plugin-specific vacuum, compaction, checkpoint, index, and backup evidence.

rules.description: Reverse-proxy upstream errors remain elevated.
rules.runbook: Separate upstream failures from client errors and inspect the affected dependency and deployment.

rules.description: Central metric ingest is materially delayed.
rules.runbook: Inspect intake rate, queue depth, storage latency, backpressure, drops, and reconnect storms.

rules.description: The bounded metrics queue is near capacity.
rules.runbook: Inspect storage throughput, producer rate, priority drops, and backpressure state.

rules.description: The bounded logs queue is near capacity.
rules.runbook: Inspect log bursts, quotas, sampling, storage health, drops, and high-priority preservation.

rules.description: Monitor storage reported a write failure.
rules.runbook: Inspect storage availability, capacity, inode state, permissions, queue protection, and recovery journal.

rules.description: Alert evaluation is running behind schedule.
rules.runbook: Inspect evaluator load, rule cardinality, storage latency, queue state, and clock health.

rules.description: An alert notification exhausted its retry policy.
rules.runbook: Inspect the delivery log, channel health, timeout, response class, credentials, and retry schedule.

rules.description: Monitor storage capacity is running low.
rules.runbook: Protect recent data, inspect retention and compaction, verify backups, and plan safe capacity recovery.

rules.description: An external dead-man check cannot reach Monitor.
rules.runbook: Check the host, network, TLS edge, SSO boundary, application readiness, collector freshness, and storage.
